meta.source: U.S. Small Business Administration, 7(a) & 504 FOIA data

definitions.loan: Any 7(a) approval record in the file, including loans later cancelled (CANCLD), matching how SBA reports approvals. Cancelled counts are shown separately.
definitions.dollars: GrossApproval, the full approved amount in nominal dollars (not adjusted for inflation).
definitions.fiscalYear: Federal fiscal year, October 1 through September 30, as recorded in ApprovalFY.
definitions.state: ProjectState, the state where the financed project is located.
definitions.industry: First two digits of the NAICS code on the loan record, grouped into NAICS sectors.

sectors.21: Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction
sectors.53: Real Estate and Rental and Leasing
sectors.56: Administrative and Support and Waste Management Services
